summary: The team discussed reducing manual meeting administration through a simple review flow and task board. This sprint prioritises accurate transcript evidence and human approval over calendar integration.
key_points: Interns spend time copying meeting notes into separate trackers.
Discussion points should not automatically become tasks.
Accurate quotes and human approval are the sprint priorities.
decisions: Keep the current teal brand colour; no change is needed.
follow_ups: Revisit the usefulness of calendar integration at the next meeting.
